Privacy Policy for TaskMate

Effective Date: November 19, 2026 | Last Updated: November 19, 2026

At TaskMate (accessible via our Android application com.taskmate.app and web platform https://taskflow.zerosyntax.in), we take your privacy and personal data protection seriously. This Privacy Policy details how we collect, process, and safeguard your information when you use our productivity and task management software.

1. Information We Collect

To provide task collaboration and deadline reminders, we process the following types of information:

  • Account Details: Your name, email address, password hash, and optional profile avatar.
  • Task and Productivity Data: Task titles, descriptions, due dates, priority labels, subtasks, checklists, completion statuses, and comments.
  • Team & Organization Metadata: Workspaces, team member assignments, roles, and collaborative permissions.
  • Communication Preferences: Optional phone number and email for receiving scheduled deadline notifications and task assignment alerts.

2. Microphone Permission & Offline Audio Recognition (Vosk Engine)

TaskMate requests the RECORD_AUDIO and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE permissions to enable hands-free offline voice task creation and voice assistant controls.

100% Local & Private Processing: All speech-to-text recognition is computed completely on your Android device using our embedded lightweight Vosk neural speech model. No audio files, voice recordings, or microphone streams are ever uploaded, recorded to disk, shared, or transmitted across the internet to our servers or third parties.

3. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used solely to deliver the TaskMate core service, including:

  • Synchronizing your tasks across your mobile app and web dashboard in real time.
  • Delivering requested deadline notifications (30-minute reminder alerts, overdue notices, and task assignment digests via in-app alerts, WhatsApp, or Google SMTP email).
  • Securing access via multi-tenant role-based access control (RBAC).
  • Ensuring system stability, preventing spam, and monitoring API performance.

4. Third-Party Services and Subprocessors

We do NOT sell, rent, or monetize your personal data. We only interface with trusted infrastructure providers required to operate the application:

  • Google Sign-In: Optional OAuth provider for authentication.
  • Email Delivery (SMTP / Nodemailer): Used strictly to dispatch user account verifications and task alerts.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Secure servers hosting MongoDB and encrypted HTTPS REST APIs.

5. Data Security and Encryption

All data in transit is encrypted using industry-standard Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3 / HTTPS). Passwords are cryptographically hashed using salt and bcrypt. Access to your tenant database is protected by JSON Web Token (JWT) verification and tenant isolation filters.

6. Account Deletion and User Rights (GDPR & Google Play Data Safety)

You have the full right to access, export, or permanently erase your personal data at any time:

  • In-App Deletion: You can delete your account and all associated tasks directly inside the app by navigating to Settings → Danger Zone → Delete Account.
  • Web Deletion Form: You can also submit an automated deletion request on our public portal at https://taskflow.zerosyntax.in/delete-account.html.

Upon deletion, all user profile records, task history, uploaded attachments, and notification subscriptions are permanently expunged from our production databases within 48 hours.

7. Children's Privacy

TaskMate is intended for workplace and individual task productivity. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13.

8. Contact Us

If you have questions, inquiries, or privacy concerns regarding this policy, please reach out to our team:
